_README: VIDEOS. Two reservations, both published:false, so neither renders and no
fabricated footage ships. Bring ONE live and it becomes the featured video
under the hero.
A LOCAL CLIP (provider 'file') — preferred for gameplay and cinematics,
because it ships no third-party script and no cookies:
1. export to public/media/video/ (MP4 always; WebM as well if you can)
2. export a poster frame to the same folder — MANDATORY
3. put the MP4 in `ref` and the WebM in `sources`, WebM first in
preference order
4. set "published": true
The page shows only the poster until the visitor presses PLAY; the video file
is not fetched before that. The native <video> element handles playback,
controls, fullscreen and Picture-in-Picture — no player library.
AN EXTERNAL CLIP (provider 'youtube' or 'vimeo'):
`ref` is the BARE ID, not a watch URL — 'dQw4w9WgXcQ', not
'https://youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ&list=...'. The embed URL is
composed by the site, so a pasted URL cannot smuggle in a playlist, an
autoplay parameter or a tracking string. A poster is still mandatory, and
the provider's script only loads once somebody presses PLAY.
See docs/MEDIA_WORKFLOW.md for resolution, duration, codec, bitrate and
whether to strip the audio track.

_note: An external alternative, for when a trailer lives on YouTube. `ref` is the bare id.
